description: This file defines the CommentInterface interface for Drupal's comment module, specifying methods and constants related to comment entities.

classes.name: CommentInterface
classes.description: Interface defining a comment entity with methods for comment properties and behaviors.

methods.name: hasParentComment
methods.description: Determines if the comment is a reply to another comment.

methods.name: getParentComment
methods.description: Returns the parent comment entity if this is a reply.

methods.name: getCommentedEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity to which the comment is attached.

methods.name: getCommentedEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity to which the comment is attached.

methods.name: getCommentedEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the type of the entity to which the comment is attached.

methods.name: setFieldName
methods.description: Sets the field ID for which this comment is attached.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field the comment is attached to.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the comment.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject of the comment.

methods.name: getAuthorName
methods.description: Returns the comment author's name.

methods.name: setAuthorName
methods.description: Sets the name of the comment's author.

methods.name: getAuthorEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the comment's author.

methods.name: getHomepage
methods.description: Returns the homepage URL of the comment's author.

methods.name: setHomepage
methods.description: Sets the homepage URL of the comment's author.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the comment's author.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the hostname of the comment's author.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Returns the thread position of the comment in alphadecimal notation.

methods.name: setThread
methods.description: Sets the thread position of the comment.

methods.name: permalink
methods.description: Returns the permalink URL for the comment.

methods.name: getTypeId
methods.description: Returns the comment type ID.
